proc show {name value} {puts [list $name $value]}
show delay [after 0]
show delay_pending [llength [after info]]
set id [after 0 {}]
show empty_timer_pending [llength [after info]]
show empty_timer_payload [after info $id]
after cancel $id
set id [after 0 set ::mark 1]
show multiword_timer_payload [after info $id]
after cancel $id
set id [after idle set ::mark 2]
show multiword_idle_payload [after info $id]
after cancel $id
show after_info [after info]
show after_cancel [after cancel nonexistent]
show event_getter [fileevent stdout writable]
fileevent stdout writable {set ::mark 3}
show event_setter [fileevent stdout writable]
fileevent stdout writable {}
show event_removed [fileevent stdout writable]
